_about: The artefacts as the owner set them (2026-10-22; the rules: docs/notes/artefacts.md; client patch 54 reads the new keys and does what no config could). Spring: passive movement speed +2 % -> +5 % and aim time -5 % (passive/aim_time_mod, the passive node patch 54 takes from max_carried_weight, 0 and no longer read), active +10 % speed as before, aim time -10 % on top (active/aim_time_mod) and no slow from bullets (active/stopping_power_mod -1: the stagger times max(0, 1 - 1)), its stamina as before. Lifebone: each of its seven regeneration modifiers timeout_add 2 -> 0 (regeneration no longer starts 2 s later), regen_add +0.1 and threshold_add +1 kept; patch 54 fills pain, body and head at its active, so its cooldown_sec 15 -> 45 (the owner, 2026-10-23; Spring 40, Onyx 60). Onyx (the owner, 2026-10-25): active damage_mul and armor_piercing_mul 0.1 -> 0.25 (-75 % for 3 s, was -90 %; -60 % first, then 75 %); patch 54 makes n Onyx fired together each active 3 s + (n - 1) s, reducing a hit once.
